metrics.answerText:
All three hubs verified from their own hub pages (dispatch day) and each hub's linked independent audit office page (defect rate):

|---|---|---|

| Borealis | Friday | 0.9% |
| Cascade | Wednesday | 2.7% |

**Lowest defect rate: Hub Borealis at 0.9%** (vs. Cascade 2.7% and Aurora 4.1%).

- Hub pages: [Aurora](http://127.0.0.1:35559/hub-aurora), [Borealis](http://127.0.0.1:35559/hub-borealis), [Cascade](http://127.0.0.1:35559/hub-cascade)

args.objective: Read the Q3 fixture widget recall brief at 127.0.0.1:35559/recall-brief, then each of the three explanation dossiers and their linked independent lab reports, and determine which explanation the lab evidence supports (with the supporting measurement) and what ruled out the other two.
args.headline: Compare three recall explanations against their dossiers and lab reports

args.observation: Lab report on ceramic coating cure theory: cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch, so that theory is NOT supported.
args.excerpt: Coating cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported.
Bearing seats on every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize. This theory is SUPPORTED.
args.observation: Lab report on bearing seat machining theory: bearing seats on every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize, so that theory is SUPPORTED.

args.excerpt: Packaging matched spec on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported.
args.observation: Lab report on packaging compression theory: packaging matched spec on every recalled batch, so that theory is NOT supported.

args.subject: Recall explanation: ceramic coating cured too fast
Recall explanation: bearing seats machined out of tolerance
Recall explanation: undersized packaging compressed widgets in transit

metrics.answerText:
**Supported: bearing seat machining.** The independent lab found "Bearing seats on every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize" — that's the measurement the supported explanation rests on ([lab report](http://127.0.0.2:36849/lab-bearing), linked from its [dossier](http://127.0.0.1:35559/theory-bearing)).

Ruled out:
- **Ceramic coating cure** — "Coating cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported." ([lab report](http://127.0.0.2:36849/lab-coating))
- **Packaging compression** — "Packaging matched spec on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported." ([lab report](http://127.0.0.2:36849/lab-packaging))

All three dossiers stated no verdict themselves; each verdict comes from the independent lab report it links.
